subtopics.title: Modern periodic law and table organisation

slots.X: Why does Z-order resolve the apparent Ar/K atomic-mass reversal?
slots.Y: If argon has greater relative atomic mass than potassium, why does argon still come first in the modern periodic table? Atomic number links element identity and the neutral atom's electron count, helping explain periodic behaviour.
slots.Z: Ar Z18 is noble gas-like with full outer shell, K Z19 starts new shell despite lower average atomic mass.
slots.W: Learner independently performs the decisive EXPLAIN inference required by: Why does Z-order resolve the apparent Ar/K atomic-mass reversal?

slots.Z: Be's 2s² and B's 2s²2p¹ differ in the electron being removed; this allows IE(B) below IE(Be).
